defs.def: accurate or true, without any mistakes 准确无误的；精确的；正确的

ex.s: For some terms, they simply copied out the correct definition; for others, they were asked to first add an error in their description of the term before  correcting the mistake.

defs.def: right and suitable, so that sth is done as it should be done 恰当的；合适的

ex.s: I really did not know whether I should continue correcting him or simply drop the matter.
ex.t: 我真的不知道是该继续纠正他，还是就此作罢。

defs.def: taking care to speak or behave in a way that follows the accepted standards or rules （举止言谈）符合公认准则的，得体的
to make sth right or accurate, for example by changing it or removing mistakes 改正；纠正；修正

ex.s: Correcting mistakes is the key to learning.
ex.t: 纠正错误是学习的关键。

ex.s: After that incident, I stopped acting as a “Chinese teacher.” Instead of correcting others when they were struggling to pronounce my name, I just smiled and nodded approvingly.
ex.t: 那次事件后，我不再担任“汉语老师”。“当别人挣扎着说出我的名字时，我没有纠正别人，我只是微笑着点头表示赞许。

ex.s: Even if this method of timekeeping is novel in its particulars，early agricultural societies also connected time to natural phenomena．In pre-Classical Greece，for instance，people“corrected”official calendars by shifting dates forward or backward to reflect the change of season．Temporal connection to the environment was vital to their survival．Likewise，river time and other timekeeping systems we're developing may encourage environmental awareness．
ex.t: 即便这种计时方式在细节上很新颖，早期的农业社会也将时间与自然现象联系起来。例如在前古典时期的希腊，人们会通过把日期向前或向后调整来“修正”官方历法，以反映季节的变化。与环境的时间联系对他们的生存至关重要。同样，我们正在开发的河流时间和其他计时系统或许也能唤起人们的环保意识。
